reason: Adds a nullable idempotency identifier and partial unique index for offline affiliate withdrawals.
risk: Adding the column briefly locks the ledger; the nonconcurrent index build can block ledger writes while scanning existing rows.
mitigation: Existing rows and old-image inserts receive NULL and are excluded from the unique index. Run through the bounded transactional migration runner and verify candidate health before switching traffic; an index-build failure rolls back the migration rather than publishing a partially initialized release.
